title: Cyberpunk 2077
provenance: user report on Highball (highball-db#2, OdynOOb) — Apple M5, macOS 15.7.3, wine-10.0 Sikarugir r6; previously community consensus (AppleGamingWiki / r-macgaming)
notes: Playable, low framerate: ~17 fps avg at 1920x1200 (Steam Deck preset + FSR 2.1 Balanced) on a base M5. Mandatory: Advertise AVX ON (engine crashes at launch otherwise); Steam launch option --launcher-skip (REDlauncher fails on OpenGL context / libEGL.dll); Steam Overlay OFF (black screen). Keep Ray Tracing OFF (software-translated slideshow). First runs stutter while shaders compile, then settle. See recipe cyberpunk-2077.
